verdict.rationale: Lindy is designed to be operated conversationally: users delegate tasks via Slack, iMessage/SMS, DMs, or ad-hoc prompts (e.g., 'Show your Slack diagnostics', daily brief prompts, ad-hoc research tasks), and it interprets natural-language requests to trigger skills, routines, and integrations without special syntax beyond a few Slack slash-commands. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of natural-language command robustness and no evidence of a broader command-line/API NL interface beyond Slack and chat channels.
